sentence: A blank engine replayed one synthetic day (605 ingest batches, 2396 events). Its 10 agent_near beliefs began as one pure pole and ended as 9 distinct points spanning 1.95 of the 2.00 Bloch range; its learnable fiber lost 9.39 bits of entropy over 87 qubits (it learned) while its world beliefs gained 11.97 bits over 21 qubits (it gave back a certainty it never earned); 18 of 19 declared axes went live; 0 actions were dispatched.
corrects: the intuition that observation lowers belief entropy; in an open belief field comprehension is differentiation of the world plus purification of the fiber, and total entropy may rise
ledger: events are the truth; the field is a cache of them (umweltd/worldstore.py)
eta_note: a proof is observation-grade on its own outputs and nothing else; it raises no claim about any product
